name: Center
description: Centers a block horizontally at reading width without side gutters.

whenToUse: Long-form text or a single form that should sit at a comfortable reading width.
whenNotToUse: The outermost page wrapper that also needs side gutters: use `l-container`.
Inside another centered block: one reading width per column is enough.

do.text: Center one column of reading content.
do.html: Articles read best at 60 to 75 characters per line.

dont.text: Don't nest centered blocks inside each other.
